title: The kb's git merge-file fact says that adjacent hunks of the two sides conflict too
goal: SP-aoiqmnc6 review G5 (ST-npj66d6y): kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md (section Two edits of one line) says both sides' hunks are taken only when one ends before the other starts, but xmerge.c v2.55.0 tests xscr1->i1 + xscr1->chg1 < xscr2->i1 (strict), so two hunks that touch (adjacent lines, no line between) conflict as well; the section names adjacent hunks as a conflict, cited to the xmerge.c source row.

run:
import sys
t=open('kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
s=t[t.find('### Two edits of one line'):];s=s[:s.find('\n#',5)]
ok='adjacent' in s.lower();print('section names adjacent hunks:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
